name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TraceEmitter.run_registered
title: The clocked registered-input machine emits exactly the framed honest trace
statement: For every 128-input 4096-gate registered NAND circuit, 128-bit witness and ciphertext of any length, the clocked deterministic emitter on the actual framed decryption input produces the frame of every sequentially computed gate value in order.
